- **MFA must be optional, OFF by default** — owner was very angry it was enforced
- **Chat endpoint `/api/ivx/owner-ai` expects `body.message` (NOT `messages`)** — this is where `classifyExecutionModeIntent` runs and sets `executionMode: 'code_change'`; worker endpoint `/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs` does NOT set executionMode (jobs default to CONTENT_REQUEST)

print("=" * 72)

# 1. Re-mint owner token
try:
    req = urllib.request.Request('https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login',
        data=json.dumps({"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}, method='POST')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
        lr = json.loads(r.read())
    tok = lr.get('accessToken') or (lr.get('data') or {}).get('accessToken') or lr.get('token')
    if tok:
        with open('/tmp/owner_at.json','w') as f:
            json.dump({"accessToken":tok,"refreshToken":lr.get('refreshToken','')}, f)
        print("[1] OWNER TOKEN:        re-minted OK (passwordless login live)")
    else:
        tok = json.load(open('/tmp/owner_at.json'))['accessToken']
        print("[1] OWNER TOKEN:        using existing token")
except Exception as e:
    tok = json.load(open('/tmp/owner_at.json'))['accessToken']
    print(f"[1] OWNER TOKEN:        using existing ({e})")
AT = tok

# 2. Runtime /health (LIVE production)
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.ivxholding.com/health', timeout=15) as r:
    h = json.loads(r.read())
rt_commit = (h.get('commit','') or '')[:14]
print(f"[2] RUNTIME /health:    commit={rt_commit}  status={h.get('status','?')}")

# 3. GitHub main HEAD (LIVE repo)
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/commits/HEAD', timeout=15) as r:
    g = json.loads(r.read())
gh_head = (g.get('sha','') or '')[:14]
print(f"[3] GITHUB main HEAD:   {gh_head}")
print(f"    msg: {(g.get('commit') or {}).get('message','?')[:80]}")

match = rt_commit == gh_head
print(f"[4] DEPLOY PROPAGATED:  runtime === GitHub HEAD → {'YES ✓ DEPLOYED LIVE' if match else 'NO ✗'}")

# 5. Probe job final state (the COMPLETED proof)
TID = 'ivx-worker-3effa344-dd8c-414f-b92d-4deb89f2afe0'
req = urllib.request.Request(f'https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/{TID}',
    headers={'Authorization':f'Bearer {AT}'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
    d = json.loads(r.read())
j = d.get('job') or d
res = j.get('result') or {}
print(f"[5] PROBE JOB:          status={j.get('status')}  stage={j.get('stage')}  progress={j.get('progressPercent')}%")
print(f"    finishedAt:         {j.get('finishedAt')}")
print(f"    stageDetail:        {j.get('stageDetail')}")
print(f"    commitSha:          {(res.get('commitSha') or '')[:14]}")
print(f"    commitUrl:          {res.get('commitUrl')}")
print(f"    finalStatus:        {res.get('finalStatus')}  ok={res.get('ok')}")
print(f"    testsPassed:        {res.get('testsPassed')}  typecheckPassed={res.get('typecheckPassed')}")
print(f"    deployRequested:    {res.get('deployRequested')}  deployId={res.get('deployId')}")

# 6. Probe commit on ivx-autonomous (GitHub API evidence)
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/branches/ivx-autonomous', timeout=15) as r:
    b = json.loads(r.read())
bhead = ((b.get('commit') or {}).get('sha') or '?')[:14]
bmsg = (((b.get('commit') or {}).get('commit') or {}).get('message') or '?')[:60]
print(f"[6] ivx-autonomous HEAD:{bhead}  ({bmsg})")

# 7. APK live
req2 = urllib.request.Request('https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.31.apk', method='HEAD')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=15) as r:
    cl = r.headers.get('Content-Length','?')
    st = r.status
print(f"[7] APK v1.4.31(63):    HTTP {st}, {cl} bytes, live at ivxholding.com/apk/")

# 8. Verify probe commit patch (real LLM-authored change)
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/commits/92b88a0ed397bf', timeout=15) as r:
    c = json.loads(r.read())
files = c.get('files') or []
patch = (files[0].get('patch') if files else '')[:180]
print(f"[8] PROBE COMMIT PATCH: file={files[0].get('filename') if files else '?'}")
print(f"    {patch}")

print("=" * 72)
print("ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA — APPROVED PLAN")
print("=" * 72)
checks = [
    ("STATUS: COMPLETED (not FAILED)", j.get('status') == 'completed'),
    ("real commit SHA present",         bool(res.get('commitSha'))),
    ("deploy ID null (not requested)",  res.get('deployId') is None),
    ("tests passed",                    res.get('testsPassed') == True),
    ("runtime === GitHub HEAD",         match),
    ("/health healthy",                 h.get('status') == 'healthy'),
    ("APK live (HTTP 200)",             st == 200),
    ("probe commit verified on GitHub", bhead == '92b88a0ed397bf'),
]
all_pass = True
for label, ok in checks:
    print(f"  {'✓ PASS' if ok else '✗ FAIL'}  {label}")
    if not ok: all_pass = False
print("=" * 72)
print(f"FINAL: {'ALL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA PASS — CERTIFIED FOR PRODUCTION' if all_pass else 'BLOCKERS REMAIN'}")
print("=" * 72)
PYEOF
